name: Khadim India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Khadim India Ltd is in manufacturing / retail business of footwear and accessories[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
KHL is in the business of Retail & Distribution of Footwears. It is the 2nd largest footwear retailer in India with a retail presence across 25 states & 5 union territories

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -11.5% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.96% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 193 days.
